get.description: Administrator with current Session. One maximum 3-second context starts before authentication, inherits earlier parent cancellation, and retains actual I/O/transaction ownership through completion. No request body, CSRF, idempotency key, scope or identity override. GET-only; all other methods return 405 and HEAD error has no body. Strict single-valued query: unknown/duplicate/array/malformed keys and bare ? rejected; RawQuery at most 32768 bytes. Explicit Problems use constant /api/v1 instance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Canonical decimal 1–200; empty, leading zero, sign, exponent and overflow are invalid.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Empty/omitted means first page. Signed System scope + canonical full Filter + fixed order; limit and current subject are not cursor bindings. Every page reauthorizes.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Optional [from,to) bound; canonical filter normalizes legal offsets/fractions to UTC. Both present require from < to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional [from,to) bound; canonical filter normalizes legal offsets/fractions to UTC. Both present require from < to.

parameters.name: actor_kind

200.description: Complete UTF-8 JSON, at most 1048576 bytes, encoded and checked before 200 headers. Current observation only.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED or SESSION_REVOKED; clear Session cookie.

403.description: FORBIDDEN or ORIGIN_DENIED, including existing boundary classification.

404.description: Absent, other scope, or unknown resource; existence is not disclosed.

405.description: GET-only. Allow: GET. HEAD has no response body.

503.description: DEPENDENCY_UNBOUND, DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE or COMMIT_UNKNOWN. Read-transaction Unknown publishes no candidate. The common retry_hint=lookup is retained for compatibility, but this domain has no command/lookup endpoint; a later GET is a new observation.
